item.title: More Than the Music: The Voices Between the Songs at Hope FM
item.description: Our DJ’s aren’t simply filling space between tracks, they are real people, sharing real faith, speaking into real lives.

item.title: New Music Friday: "Dusty Bibles" by Josiah Queen
item.description: Happy Friday! We’re back with another new song that hits close to home, and Josiah Queen’s “Dusty Bibles” is an honest reminder to slow down, check our priorities, and reconnect with what truly matters. It’s honest, reflective, and a little uncomfortable in the best way. Instead of pointing fingers, it holds up a mirror and asks us to look at our own lives and priorities.The heart of this song is a simple but powerful question: what are we giving our time and attention to? item.title: New Music Friday: "World on Fire" by for KING + COUNTRY
item.description: “World on Fire” by for KING + COUNTRY is one of those songs that makes you want to turn it up the volume and live a little louder for Jesus. It’s bold, energetic, and full of purpose, capturing that moment when faith goes from something you talk about to something you truly live out.At its core, this song is about transformation. item.title: Meaningful Milestones
item.description: This month marks a meaningful milestone for Hope FM — 30 years of ministry — and for me personally, 25 years of walking through these doors, doing work I still can’t believe I get to call my job.I’m beyond blessed because I get to do something I absolutely love.Growing up, I always had my ear to the radio. item.title: New Music Friday: "The Love I Have For You" by Colton Dixon
item.description: This song feels like a gentle reminder straight from God’s heart. It starts in that place we all know too well... anxiety, exhaustion, feeling distant, wondering how we’re going to make it through another hard stretch. And then comes the reassurance: you’re not alone, and you never have been.It reminds me of Isaiah 41:10:“So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
